x: Tobin was still our first man, and had lost a few places, as had Lucas and Morrell. Murdoch had gained, so had Clements and Stride. These two were running very strongly and we still hoped there might be a chance of a place.
The course was altered slightly to cut out the brook but Stride's time of 29 mins. 15 secs. is, nevertheless, of the same excellent standard set by Stimpson and Clements in previous years.

Stride (12) and Boyden (14), who showed splendid promise on graduating from the junior section. Good luck to them both; and a special word for George Still, who at 62 can cover ten miles at what seems to us a phenomenal pace—we expect him to win the race when he has had a little more experience!
Herbert had dropped to 65th, Stride was running really well and had come up to 40th. After Herbert there was quite a patch of claret and gold.
